page.overview:
Who is Chelsea?

Chelsea was a model of a genetically modified Triceratops created by Joe Laudati. The model was a partner model to the Robertosaurus Rex. It was a concept for an unproduced Jurassic Park toyline that would have involved "nastier" dinosaurs fighting against soldiers with "dino-fighting" gear and vehicles. The client for the model was Robert Yee. The original model was created in Feburary 2006.

A week after the Robertosaurus Rex was created, Robert asked for a Triceratops model to go with it. Joe designed the Triceratops based off of the original Jurassic Park design, but made it look angrier. The Triceratops was bred to be deep blue and purple and had a meaner temperament. Chelsea was never given a species name. Joe stated, "We didn’t have a ‘species name’ but I guess it would be triceratops horridus." Ultimately, the model never went into production in the toyline.

The molds of the Triceratops were later used to make resin castings for model kits, which were sold. In December 2025, Joe stated that he still had a model of the Triceratops.
